rules.title: Source Approval Lifecycle Gate
rules.originalQuotation: The content sheet status must be confirmed as Approved prior to final production release.
rules.reason: Content sheet has status "Unspecified". Because source is not final approved copy, discrepancies cannot be confirmed as definitive production errors without brand owner resolution.

rules.title: Source Formulation Copy Concordance
rules.originalQuotation: Artwork copy must match approved content sheet copy across ingredients, percentages, and nutrition values.
rules.reason: Discrepancies detected between content sheet and printed carton: Honey percentage mismatch (9% in sheet vs 1% on carton), plus unapproved carton ingredients (Walnuts, Flax Seeds, Dried Strawberries, Pumpkin Seeds).

rules.title: Statement of Identity Prominence
rules.originalQuotation: Product statement of identity (GRANOLA) must appear prominently on the Front PDP in bold, legible typography.
rules.reason: "GRANOLA" appears on the Front panel as dominant display typography (71.3 pt Acorn-Bold).

rules.title: Net Quantity PDP Placement and Dual Units
rules.originalQuotation: Net quantity must be declared on the Front PDP in both US customary and metric units under 21 CFR 101.7.
rules.reason:
Net quantity "NUTRITION DECLARATION
Typical Values per 100g
Energy 1868kJ / 445kcal
Fat 15g
Carbohydrate 65g
Protein 9.2g
Nutrition Facts
8 servings per container
Serving size 2/3 cup (55g)
Calories 230
Total Fat 8g
Total Carbohydrate 37g
Protein 5g" on unknown panel does not meet US requirements: Missing US customary declaration (ounces / pounds). 15 U.S.C. 1453 and 21 CFR 101.7 require dual declaration in both US Customary and metric units. Net quantity is located on "unknown" panel instead of the Principal Display Panel (PDP) as required by 21 CFR 101.7.

rules.title: Manufacturer / Distributor Postal Identification
rules.originalQuotation: Business name and complete address (city, state, ZIP) must appear on the information panel per 21 CFR 101.5.
rules.reason: Carton displays "PRODUCED BY DANCING FISH GRANOLA CO." without street, city, state, or postal ZIP code.

artworkEvidence.quote: PRODUCED BY DANCING FISH GRANOLA CO.

rules.title: Customer Contact Channel Requirement
rules.originalQuotation: Packaging must include a consumer inquiry channel (website or toll-free telephone number).
rules.reason: No consumer telephone number or website URL detected on packaging panels.

rules.title: Storage Instructions Presence
rules.originalQuotation: Storage instructions ("Store in a cool, dry place...") must appear on the information panel.
rules.reason: Storage instruction "Store in a cool, dry place..." is present on the Back panel.

artworkEvidence.quote: Store in a cool, dry place.

rules.title: Date Coding / Lot Area Clearance
rules.originalQuotation: Best-before notice ("see base of pack") requires an unvarnished, copy-free 40 x 15 mm coding window on the carton base.
rules.reason: Carton text states "see base of pack". Base flaps carry no native text, but unvarnished coding window clearance requires prepress plate verification.

rules.title: Nutrition Facts Panel Structural Format
rules.originalQuotation: Nutrition Facts panel must be titled, boxed, and terminate with the standard FDA % Daily Value footnote.
rules.reason: Nutrition Facts panel is structured on the Left side panel with required title and FDA % Daily Value footnote statement.

artworkEvidence.quote: Nutrition Facts ... The % Daily Value (DV) tells you

rules.title: Nutrition Arithmetic and Daily Value Accuracy
rules.originalQuotation: All declared %DV values and total calories must align mathematically with stated nutrient amounts under FDA 21 CFR 101.9.
rules.reason: 10 declared % Daily Values conflict with computed FDA 2016 standards (Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Cholesterol, Sodium, Carbs, Fiber, Vit D, Calcium, Iron, Potassium), and calories (166 kcal) diverge from Atwater sum (535 kcal).

rules.title: Prohibition of EU Market Elements on US Packaging
rules.originalQuotation: Packaging designed for the US market must not display EU-specific icons, kJ energy, or EU Annex II allergen phrases.
rules.reason: EU Reference Intake energy icons ("197kJ 4%"), "Saturates", "Salt", and EU phrasing "Cereals Containing Gluten" detected on US carton artwork.

rules.title: Tree Nut Allergen Disclosure Standard
rules.originalQuotation: Specific tree nut allergens in recipe must be disclosed with clear consumer statement.
rules.reason: Almonds, Pecans, and Walnuts are formulation ingredients, but carton provides only a precautionary "May Contain" statement without a "Contains:" statement.

rules.title: No Added Sugar Claim Substantiation
rules.originalQuotation: Product may not bear "No Added Sugar" claims if formulation contains added sugars or caloric sweeteners.
rules.reason: Carton displays "NO ADDED SUGAR", but recipe contains Honey, Coconut Sugar, and Cane Sugar.

sourceEvidence.quote: Honey (9%), Coconut Sugar, Crystallized Ginger (cane sugar)

rules.title: Vegan Claim Substantiation and Terminology
rules.originalQuotation: Vegan declarations must be supported by 100% plant-based formulation without bee products.
rules.reason: Carton displays "Suitable for Vegans", but recipe contains Honey (bee product) and nutrition panel declares 45mg cholesterol.

rules.title: Organic Certification Documentation
rules.originalQuotation: Use of "Certified Organic" or USDA Organic requires active certificate on file prior to run.
rules.reason: Carton claims "certified organic" and "Organic Wholegrain Oat Flakes (79%)". Verification requires human auditor confirmation of certifier certificate.

rules.title: Prohibited Non-GMO Phrasing
rules.originalQuotation: The phrasing "GMO free" is prohibited by company policy; use "Non-GMO Project Verified" when authorized.
rules.reason: "GMO free" phrasing detected on carton (Back panel and Top flap), violating internal policy.

rules.title: Grain Content Claim Approval
rules.originalQuotation: Descriptors such as "HIGH-GRAIN" require regulatory nutritional substantiation.
rules.reason: "HIGH-GRAIN" claim displayed on Top flap (Front). Must be reviewed against whole-grain nutrient content claim guidelines.

rules.title: Mandatory Copy Minimum Font Size
rules.originalQuotation: Storage instructions and statutory disclosures must be set at minimum 6.0 pt native font size.
rules.reason: Storage instructions are set at 5.8 pt Acorn-Regular, failing the mandatory 6.0 pt company minimum (Ingredients at 6.0 pt and Allergen at 6.0 pt pass).

artworkEvidence.quote: Store in a cool, dry place

rules.title: Obsolete / Occluded Art Object Cleanliness
rules.originalQuotation: Legacy artwork components (such as superseded EU tables) must be deleted from PDF objects, not covered by opaque fills.
rules.reason: An obsolete EU nutrition table ("Typical Values per 100g") is retained in native PDF text stream (seqno 227) and masked with an opaque white rectangle (seqno 241) instead of being purged.

rules.title: How2Recycle Mark Verification
rules.originalQuotation: How2Recycle paperboard icon indicated in specification must be verified on artwork.
rules.reason: Content sheet specifies How2Recycle mark. Present on carton as non-text vector graphic/image asset; requires visual confirmation.

rules.title: Front-of-Pack Carbon Footprint Badge (Proposed Standard)
rules.originalQuotation: Products should display verified CO2e carbon footprint badge.
rules.reason: Rule DF-21 has lifecycle state "PROPOSED" (not in force). Per rule governance policy, proposed rules must never produce a finding.
